The '''Calamari sector''', also known as '''Mon Calamari Space''' or '''Calamari Space''', was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==Description==
[[File:Calamari_sector.jpg|thumb|left|225px|The Calamari sector and its surrounding [[Sector/Legends|sectors]]]]
Planets in the Calamari sector included [[Buchich]], [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] (Mon Calamari), [[Damendine system/Legends|Damendine]], [[Eridicon IV]], [[Hinakuu]], [[Krinemonen]], [[Mantan]], [[Minntooine/Legends|Minntooine]], [[Pammant/Legends|Pammant]], [[Ruisto]], [[Sanctuary/Legends|Sanctuary]], and [[Talas]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Calamari sector had two significant [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] connecting it to the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The [[Overic Griplink/Legends|Overic Griplink]] connected the sector to the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] at [[Quermia/Legends|Quermia]], via [[Munto Codru/Legends|Munto Codru]] and [[Pakuuni/Legends|Pakuuni]]. The [[Giblim Route]] connected the sector to the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] at [[Dellalt/Legends|Dellalt]]. A third hyperlane, [[Prously's Rim Run]], connected the sector to [[Dornea/Legends|Dornea]] but terminated at [[Baros]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
The [[cavitation hyperdrive]] invented by the Calamari mathematician [[Q-Viza]] enabled the Calamari people to reach the nearest star systems thousands of years before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It began with the colonization of Ruisto, Mantan and Hinakuu, between [[4400 BBY]] and [[4200 BBY]]. The Calamari's interstellar federation came to grow out of the establishment of colonies meant to function as a "reef" of breakwater settlements that protected the main world. During their pre-[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] expansion era, the Calamari maintained relations with nearby alien civilizations, such as the [[Lamproid/Legends|lamproids]] of [[Florn/Legends|Florn]] and the [[Veubg]]ri of [[Gbu]]. The Republic made first contact with Mon Calamari when Republic scouts reached Ruisto in [[4166 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

In fear of being left behind by their Calamari counterparts, the Quarren established colonies on uninhabited worlds like Pammant, Minntooine and Buchich. When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] divided societies in Calamari sector, some of these Quarren worlds manufactured [[Warship/Legends|warships]] for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

During the Galactic Civil War, the Calamari and Quarren peoples rebelled against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] occupation forces, driving them out of the sector, and giving the emerging [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] a safe haven to build up their forces. It was the location of several [[Mon Calamari Shipyards/Legends|shipyards]] used by the Alliance during this period and was in close proximity to other notably anti-Imperial worlds, such as [[Dornea/Legends|Dornea]], [[Hast]], [[New Alderaan/Legends|New Alderaan]] and [[Solay]].<ref name="TEA" /> However, a direct consequence of their driving out the Imperials was that a massive Imperial invasion force was approaching the sector during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], and had the Rebels lost during that battle, they would have only a few months to contemplate their mistake before the second Death Star arrived to destroy Mon Calamari and end their insurrection.<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> Following the Battle of Endor, the Calamari sector was among the first sectors to throw off the Empire.<ref name="RECG" />

It later became a bulwark against the forces of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], during their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="GATORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>

The sector was represented by [[Tikkes/Legends|Tikkes]], [[Tundra Dowmeia/Legends|Tundra Dowmeia]] and [[Meena Tills/Legends|Meena Tills]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], [[Timi Rotramel]] in the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]], [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] on the [[New Republic Provisional Council]]; then by [[Q-Varx]], [[Cilghal]], [[Pwoe]] and [[Gron Marrab]] in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic]]/[[Galactic Alliance Senate]].
